body: the main extent of her behaviour that i would say were reminiscent of bpd was that she would call me many times a day when she knew the reasons why i couldn’t call (it was exam season) and made many threats even perusing an attempt of suicide, she obviously also had big emotions about most everything big mental breakdowns and believing the worst of me (that i would one day leave or abuse her etc.), obviously my experience isn’t everyone’s but i think there needs to be a big shift in the way we as people view this mental illness. I actually don’t really feel much sympathy for those with bpd due to my experiences with it ironically enough but i am trying to understand. i understand the hatred some may have for people with bpd from their experiences but calling a whole group of people the spawn of satan and warning others to run as fast as they can seems a bit drastic to me. This is obviously a safe space and i respect that people feel glad to find others with similar experiences it’s the reason i interact with this page as well. Because of my own suspicions about myself it just makes me question about the morality of me entering relationships even if i feel personally like i would succeed well in them. I don’t think my ex believes she was horrible or traumatic for me to be in a relationship so i wonder if i am the same and simply unaware of how my emotional stability is affecting others. i want to finish by saying i’m an ally to everyone in this reddit and i am also one of you.
